001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Control-IQ's rolling two-hour total of the insulin it commanded itself, written every 15 minutes
009 * (a 900-second timer from pump start-up, in the same second of the minute as
010 * {@link DailyBasalHistoryLog}). The three floats are sums in units over the last 24 five-minute
011 * Control-IQ cycles: for every cycle in which the algorithm was in control ({@link
012 * BasalDeliveryHistoryLog} source ALGORITHM or TEMP_RATE_AND_ALGORITHM), the commanded basal rate
013 * times 5 minutes, plus each automatic correction bolus. User-initiated boluses are not counted.
014 * Rebuilt from the 227 cycle times, BasalDelivery (279) rates and automatic BolusDelivery (280)
015 * records, all three fields matched within 0.005 U in 84-100% of 1,241 records from four pumps
016 * (t:slim X2 and Mobi); the misses are one five-minute slot off, for exactly two hours.
017 *
018 * <p>All three are exactly 0 until Control-IQ has run in closed loop since the pump last started
019 * ({@link ArmInitHistoryLog}). When closed loop stops, old cycles still expire, so the sums fall to
020 * float rounding residue (magnitude below 2e-5 U), not to exactly 0.
021 *
022 * <p>These are pump-internal Control-IQ values: do not use them for dosing or IOB.
023 *
024 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 237 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
025 * app's history log list. {@link #getUnknown22()} is exposed raw. See
026 * https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/146.
027 */
028
029/**
030 * History log record Control-IQ Automated Insulin, opCode 237, size 26.
031 *
032 * <br>
033 *
034 * Control-IQ's rolling two-hour total of the insulin it commanded itself, written every 15 minutes
035 * (a 900-second timer from pump start-up, in the same second of the minute as
036 * {@link DailyBasalHistoryLog}). The three floats are sums in units over the last 24 five-minute
037 * Control-IQ cycles: for every cycle in which the algorithm was in control ({@link
038 * BasalDeliveryHistoryLog} source ALGORITHM or TEMP_RATE_AND_ALGORITHM), the commanded basal rate
039 * times 5 minutes, plus each automatic correction bolus. User-initiated boluses are not counted.
040 * Rebuilt from the 227 cycle times, BasalDelivery (279) rates and automatic BolusDelivery (280)
041 * records, all three fields matched within 0.005 U in 84-100% of 1,241 records from four pumps
042 * (t:slim X2 and Mobi); the misses are one five-minute slot off, for exactly two hours.
043 *
044 * <p>All three are exactly 0 until Control-IQ has run in closed loop since the pump last started
045 * ({@link ArmInitHistoryLog}). When closed loop stops, old cycles still expire, so the sums fall to
046 * float rounding residue (magnitude below 2e-5 U), not to exactly 0.
047 *
048 * <p>These are pump-internal Control-IQ values: do not use them for dosing or IOB.
049 *
050 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 237 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
051 * app's history log list. {@link #getUnknown22()} is exposed raw. See
052 * https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/146.
053 *
054 * 
055 * <table border='1'>
056 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
057 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>237</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
058 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Control-IQ Automated Insulin"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
059 * </table>
060 */@HistoryLogProps(
061    opCode = 237,
062    displayName = "Control-IQ Automated Insulin"
063)
064public class ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
065    /** Larger than the float residue the sums settle at, smaller than one 5-minute basal slot. */
066    public static final float RESIDUE_THRESHOLD_UNITS = 0.001f;
067
068    private float totalInsulin;
069    private float basalAboveProfileInsulin;
070    private float autoBolusInsulin;
071    private long unknown22;
072
073    public ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog() {}
074    public ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float totalInsulin, float basalAboveProfileInsulin, float autoBolusInsulin, long unknown22) {
075        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
076        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, totalInsulin, basalAboveProfileInsulin, autoBolusInsulin, unknown22);
077        this.totalInsulin = totalInsulin;
078        this.basalAboveProfileInsulin = basalAboveProfileInsulin;
079        this.autoBolusInsulin = autoBolusInsulin;
080        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
081    }
082
083    public int typeId() {
084        return 237;
085    }
086
087    /**
088     * <table border="1">
089     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog:</caption>
090     * <tr><td><code>totalInsulin</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
091     * <tr><td><code>basalAboveProfileInsulin</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
092     * <tr><td><code>autoBolusInsulin</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
093     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
094     * </table>
095     */
096    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
097        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
098        this.cargo = raw;
099        parseBase(raw);
100        this.totalInsulin = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10);
101        this.basalAboveProfileInsulin = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
102        this.autoBolusInsulin = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
103        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
104    }
105
106    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float totalInsulin, float basalAboveProfileInsulin, float autoBolusInsulin, long unknown22) {
107        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
108            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(237, 0),
109            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
110            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
111            Bytes.toFloat(totalInsulin),
112            Bytes.toFloat(basalAboveProfileInsulin),
113            Bytes.toFloat(autoBolusInsulin),
114            Bytes.toUint32(unknown22)));
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * Basal Control-IQ commanded over the last two hours plus its automatic correction boluses.
119     * Always at least {@link #getBasalAboveProfileInsulin()} + {@link #getAutoBolusInsulin()}.
120     *
121     * @return insulin in units (float32 at offset 10)
122     */
123    public float getTotalInsulin() {
124        return totalInsulin;
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * For each cycle in the window, max(0, commanded rate - profile rate) times 5 minutes: the
129     * insulin Control-IQ added by raising basal above the profile.
130     *
131     * @return insulin in units (float32 at offset 14)
132     */
133    public float getBasalAboveProfileInsulin() {
134        return basalAboveProfileInsulin;
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * Automatic correction boluses in the window, counted at the Control-IQ cycle that decided them
139     * (47-141 s before the BolusDelivery STARTED record) and dropped two hours later. Matched
140     * the requested amount of all 20 automatic boluses seen, to 0.001 U. Three times it also held
141     * an amount with no automatic bolus record; each time the Control-IQ cycle fell during a user
142     * bolus.
143     *
144     * @return insulin in units (float32 at offset 18)
145     */
146    public float getAutoBolusInsulin() {
147        return autoBolusInsulin;
148    }
149
150    /**
151     * @return {@link #getTotalInsulin()} minus {@link #getAutoBolusInsulin()}: the basal Control-IQ
152     * commanded over the last two hours, in units
153     */
154    public float getBasalInsulin() {
155        return totalInsulin - autoBolusInsulin;
156    }
157
158    /**
159     * @return false when every sum is 0 or float residue, i.e. Control-IQ commanded no insulin in
160     * the last two hours (or has not run in closed loop since the pump started)
161     */
162    public boolean hasAutomatedInsulin() {
163        return Math.abs(totalInsulin) >= RESIDUE_THRESHOLD_UNITS
164            || Math.abs(basalAboveProfileInsulin) >= RESIDUE_THRESHOLD_UNITS
165            || Math.abs(autoBolusInsulin) >= RESIDUE_THRESHOLD_UNITS;
166    }
167
168    /**
169     * 0 in all 4,668 records seen.
170     *
171     * @return raw uint32 at offset 22
172     */
173    public long getUnknown22() {
174        return unknown22;
175    }
176}
